    return {k:int(v) for k,v in (line.split('=',1) for line in (root/rel).read_text().splitlines())}
control_wrapper=wrapper_seconds('reports/documentation/20261018/optuna_implementation/qualification/attempt01.wrapper.txt')
analysis_wrapper=wrapper_seconds('reports/documentation/20261018/optuna_implementation/repair/qualification/attempt07.wrapper.txt')

source_checks=[]
for rec in calc['sources']:
    p=root/rec['path']
    if any(x in rec['path'] for x in ('native/result.json','attempt01.wrapper','attempt01/unittest','attempt07.wrapper','attempt07/unittest','positive_ranking_result/job.wrapper','positive_ranking_result/job.console','optuna_run.py','optuna_control.py','optuna_verify.py','optuna_search.py','replay_diagnostics.py','test_step28_optuna.py')):

result={'scope':'Static saved-field arithmetic only; no project import/evaluation or native execution','basis':{'R':R,'r_I_by_arm':{a:r['measurements']['r_I'] for a,r in native['arms'].items()},'W_I_by_arm':{a:r['measurements']['W_I'] for a,r in native['arms'].items()},'T_C_wrapper':control_wrapper,'T_F_wrapper':analysis_wrapper,'historical_wrapper_seconds':old_wall,'historical_final_update_elapsed_seconds':last['elapsed_seconds'],'T_tail':tail},'shared':checks,'shared_sum':sum(independent.values()),'shared_cap_sum':900+3600+600,'payload_identity_checks':source_checks,'workload_counts':{'search_weight_hashes':36*2,'joint_endpoint_weight_hashes':9*2,'joint_metric_sets':9*2*3,'joint_diagnostic_captures':9*2*6,'tail_proxy_includes_historical_capture_evaluations_per_new_run':2*2*6},'exceptions':[]}
assert all(x['size_equal'] and x['sha256_equal'] for x in source_checks)
